name: Seafood Gratin Pasta Bake with Béchamel

components.name: Seafood Gratin Pasta Bake

ingredients.name: Raw mixed edible seafood: fish, peeled prawns, squid and mussel meat
Olive oil for seafood and leek

steps: Heat oven to 180 C. Boil macaroni until just firmer than al dente, drain and place in a deep baking dish.
In a very hot skillet quickly sear raw seafood in oil without fully cooking, then move it to the baking dish. Cook chopped leek and garlic briefly in the same pan.
Melt butter in the pan and stir in flour to form a paste. Add milk gradually, whisking until smooth, then heat until thick and finish with parmesan, salt and pepper.
Combine pasta, seafood and leeks; pour béchamel evenly over and finish with panko, parsley and grated parmesan.
Bake about 20-25 minutes until top is golden and seafood reaches 63 C. Rest briefly and divide into four complete servings.

Dietary: Contains fish, crustaceans, molluscs, wheat and dairy.

Refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers at 4°C or colder, for 3–4 days at most, and follow the shorter seafood limit above. Cook fish and shellfish to 63°C and reheat leftovers to at least 74°C.

Refrigerate at 4 C or below for 3-4 days maximum; freeze later-week portions soon after cooking.
Reheat cooked leftovers to 74 C. Cook fish and crustaceans to 63 C (145 F) or applicable local food-safety standard. Use a food thermometer.
When a recipe includes rice, cool it rapidly and store cold immediately; avoid leaving cooked rice at room temperature.
Freeze in suitable airtight food-safe containers. Defrost in refrigerator, not on counter. Reheat crisp foods in oven when possible.
